title: bartlettina oresbia
intro: Bartlettina oresbia, commonly known as the Oresbia, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family, native to Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bartlettina oresbia include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
